description: Find the best (highest) decimal price for one side of one market across bookmakers, and show the rest of the field. Only available prices count. For line and total markets prices are compared at one line only: the line you give, else the line most bookmakers quote. Give market and side, or an exact outcome_id (oc_...) from get_odds with all_markets.

line.description: Compare at this line. For a line market this is the chosen side's own handicap, for example -2.5

outcome_id.description: Exact outcome_id (oc_...) from get_odds with all_markets, instead of market and side, for any market

side.description: home or away (h2h, line; competitor_1 or competitor_2 in tennis and UFC), draw (h2h_3way), over or under (total)

name: best_price
title: Best price
